newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech firms gain control of utility MST heat-CTK.
newsitem.headline: Czech firms gain control of utility MST heat-CTK.

text.p: The largest Czech coal mining concern, OKD a.s. and a local firm, Prosper Trading a.s., have jointly acquiried over 51 percent of the heating utility Moravskoslezske Teplarny a.s., the local agency CTK reported on Friday.

It quoted a Teplarny official from headquarters in Ostrava as saying the two companies acquired most of the stake from the fourth biggest bank in the country, IPB a.s. which controlled about 30 percent share of Moravskoslezske.

It said the second largest shareholder of the utility were the mutual funds managed by Sporitelni Investicni Spolecnnost with a stake of over 20 percent and General and Empolyment Service with 13 percent.
Remaining shareholders hold less than 10 percent.
Company officials were not immediately available for further comment.
